module purpose: neorv32_onewire stores a bus-written control setting (enable, one-cycle clear, prescaler select, clock divider), queues bus-written command words (operation code and data byte) in a transmit FIFO sub-unit, and runs a serial engine that, paced by a tick derived from a selected clkgen_i bit and the divider, drives onewire_o low and high in timed slots, samples onewire_i, and pushes the assembled byte and a presence bit into a receive FIFO sub-unit that bus reads return; it also returns control and status on bus reads, exports the enable on clkgen_en_o and raises irq_o when enabled with an empty transmit queue and an idle engine.

use-case flows.value: control setting (enable, clear request, prescaler select, clock divider) taken from bus write data at the control address
command word (operation code and data byte) pushed into the transmit queue by a bus write at the data address
command dispatch: the idle engine starts when a queued command is waiting, decodes it, and pops it from the transmit queue on the next tick
time-base tick produced from the selected clkgen_i bit and the clock divider
slot sequencing: phase, slot position and bit count deciding when onewire_o is pulled low or released and when a transfer completes
sampling of onewire_i into the received bits and the presence bit, written into the receive queue when a transfer completes
status (transmit queue full, receive data available, line sense, busy) on control reads, and the interrupt request
received byte and presence bit popped from the receive queue on a data-address read; stored control settings returned on a control-address read
rstn_i clears the control, tick, engine, line-output and interrupt registers; a cleared enable or a clear request flushes both queues, and a cleared enable returns the engine to phase 00
